description: Read account credit data. action=balance (default) returns the current credit balance in microcents (1,000,000 microcents = $1.00) with formatted values. action=usage returns usage statistics. action=limits returns this API key's budget (limit, used, remaining, reset time) and the account budget. action=usage_by_tag returns spend and request counts per request tag (pass tag for one tag, with its cap; since bounds the window); failed and refunded requests are excluded. Read-only; call it before an expensive crawl or batch to confirm there are enough credits and budget.

since.description: With action=usage_by_tag: only count requests at or after this ISO 8601 time.

tag.description: With action=usage_by_tag: return usage for this one tag instead of the list of all tags.

name: alterlab_balance
title: Balance and Usage
